projects_date_order.name: projects_date_order
projects_date_order.value: end_date is null or start_date is null or end_date >= start_date

project_stages_date_order.name: project_stages_date_order
project_stages_date_order.value: end_date is null or start_date is null or end_date >= start_date

proposals_expiry_after_issue.name: proposals_expiry_after_issue
proposals_expiry_after_issue.value: expiry_date is null or issue_date is null or expiry_date >= issue_date

contracts_end_after_start.name: contracts_end_after_start
contracts_end_after_start.value: end_date is null or start_date is null or end_date >= start_date

variation_order_events_actor_channel_che.name: variation_order_events_actor_channel_check
variation_order_events_actor_channel_che.value: actor_channel is null or actor_channel in ('staff', 'client')

design_engagements_rom_range.name: design_engagements_rom_range
design_engagements_rom_range.value: rom_high is null or rom_low is null or rom_high >= rom_low

engagement_events_client_issuance_unique.name: engagement_events_client_issuance_unique
engagement_events_client_issuance_unique.where: actor_channel = 'client' and acknowledged_issue_at is not null

client_payment_claims_resolution.name: client_payment_claims_resolution
client_payment_claims_resolution.value:
case status::text
      when 'pending'   then resolved_at is null and resolved_by is null and confirmed_payment_event_id is null
      when 'dismissed' then resolved_at is not null and resolved_by is not null and confirmed_payment_event_id is null
      when 'confirmed' then resolved_at is not null and confirmed_payment_event_id is not null
      else true end
